title: 428. The truth about Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs

sentences.en: This is an iHeart Podcast, Guaranteed Human.

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在努力以一种现实的方式优先考虑我的健康，而让我保持动力的东西就是我的WHOOP。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供了所有这些数据和模式，让我能做出更好的决定，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该努力。

sentences.en: Don't miss the historical cinema event of the year,
sentences.zh: 千万不要错过年度历史电影盛事，

sentences.zh: 《起义》，12月3日上映。

sentences.en: Hello everybody, I'm Gemma Speck, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through the biggest changes, moments, and transitions of our 20s,
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是杰玛·斯佩克，欢迎回到《20多岁的心理学》，在这个播客中，我们探讨20多岁时最大的变化、时刻和转变，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello everybody, welcome back to the show, welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到节目，欢迎回到播客。

sentences.en: It is so great to have you here, back for another episode, as we of course break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目，当然，我们要继续剖析20多岁的心理学。

sentences.en: Today, I have another bonus episode for you.
sentences.zh: 今天，我为你准备了另一期特别节目。

sentences.en: If you are new to this series, our bonus episodes are our smaller, bite-sized episodes that seek to break down and debunk certain famous psychology theories
sentences.zh: 如果你是这个系列的新听众，我们的特别节目是简短精炼的剧集，旨在拆解和揭穿某些著名的心理学理论，

sentences.en: or pseudoscientific ideas you may see a lot online, or hear everybody from your mom to your best friend to the guy on the train talking about.
sentences.zh: 或者你在网上经常看到，或者从你妈妈、最好的朋友到火车上的路人都在谈论的伪科学观点。

sentences.en: Basically, this series is, it's mythbusters, but for psychology and in podcast form.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这个系列就是心理学界的“流言终结者”，只不过是以播客的形式呈现。

sentences.en: We've done The Truth About Dopamine, we've done personality tests, narcissism, flow states, whether the frontal lobe actually develops at 25,
sentences.zh: 我们做过关于多巴胺的真相、人格测试、自恋、心流状态、前额叶皮层是否真的在25岁发育成熟等话题，

sentences.en: and today, we are doing Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs, and why our understanding of it is nowhere near where it needs to be, and also why the modern day depiction
sentences.zh: 而今天，我们要讨论马斯洛需求层次理论，以及为什么我们对它的理解远未达到应有的水平，还有为什么现代对马斯洛需求层次的描述，

sentences.en: of Maslow's Hierarchy is actually incredibly inaccurate, maybe even false.
sentences.zh: 实际上是非常不准确的，甚至可能是错误的。

sentences.en: It's a huge episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一期内容量很大的节目。

sentences.en: I'm not going to waste any more time talking about things that aren't Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs.
sentences.zh: 我不想再浪费时间谈论那些不是马斯洛需求层次理论的东西了。

sentences.en: Let's jump straight into it.
sentences.zh: 让我们直接进入主题。

sentences.en: If you have a psychology background, even casually, if you have dabbled in the self-help space, I think it's safe to assume you have come across the Hierarchy of Needs.
sentences.zh: 如果你有心理学背景，哪怕只是略知一二，或者涉足过自助领域，我想可以肯定地说，你一定接触过需求层次理论。

sentences.en: And the Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs was formed from his major work that he published, which was A Theory of Human Motivation.
sentences.zh: 马斯洛需求层次理论源于他发表的主要著作《人类动机理论》。

sentences.en: Even if you don't know what I'm talking about by name, you have seen an image of this.
sentences.zh: 即使你不知道我说的名字是什么，你也一定见过它的图片。

sentences.en: You have seen an image of this in your career counselor's office, in a science textbook, on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 你在职业顾问的办公室、科学教科书或Instagram上都见过这张图。

sentences.en: It's usually represented as a pyramid with five layers, and it's built on a simple idea.
sentences.zh: 它通常被表现为一个五层的金字塔，建立在一个简单的理念之上。

sentences.en: Before you can focus on becoming your fullest self, you need to satisfy the most fundamental human needs, which sit at the base of the pyramid, and then you work your way up.
sentences.zh: 在你专注于成为最完整的自我之前，你需要满足金字塔底部的最基本人类需求，然后一步步向上攀升。

sentences.en: Now, this theory was developed by Abraham Maslow.
sentences.zh: 这个理论是由亚伯拉罕·马斯洛提出的。

sentences.en: He's an American psychologist, and he first kind of put this together in the 1940s.
sentences.zh: 他是一位美国心理学家，在20世纪40年代首次整理出了这个理论。

sentences.en: Maslow famously practiced a form of psychology called humanistic psychology, which prioritizes the push towards human flourishing and self-realization.
sentences.zh: 马斯洛以推崇一种名为人本主义心理学的流派而闻名，该流派优先考虑推动人类的繁荣和自我实现。

sentences.en: And this hierarchy is like the cornerstone of this specific psychological discipline, because it suggests that needs at the bottom of the pyramid, whilst seemingly basic,
sentences.zh: 这个层次结构就像是这一特定心理学学科的基石，因为它暗示了金字塔底部的需求，虽然看起来很基础，

sentences.en: are essential for survival.
sentences.zh: 却是生存所必需的。

sentences.en: And they're also not examined enough by psychologists.
sentences.zh: 而且它们也没有得到心理学家足够的审视。

sentences.en: And it basically instructed the academic, the psychological community, like, if you want to, if you want your patience, if you want humanity to thrive and to be fulfilled,
sentences.zh: 它基本上是在指导学术界和心理学界：如果你想让你的病人、让全人类繁荣并获得满足，

sentences.en: we need to pay more attention to things like emotional security, financial security,
sentences.zh: 我们需要更多地关注情感安全、经济安全，

sentences.en: just physical security, having food, having water.
sentences.zh: 以及单纯的身体安全，比如有食物、有水。

sentences.en: And he basically, he used this theory that he came up with to describe a lot of things and a lot of problems he saw in psychology and with humanity,
sentences.zh: 他基本上利用他提出的这个理论来描述他在心理学和人类身上看到的许多事情和问题，

sentences.en: like the need to address poverty in order to achieve greater psychological and intellectual thriving in society, why we can't be creative or answer deep questions about life
sentences.zh: 比如为了在社会中实现更大的心理和智力繁荣，需要解决贫困问题；为什么我们在脱离生存困境之前，无法进行创造或回答关于生命的深奥问题，

sentences.en: until we're out of a place of survival, and why emotional security matters just as much as physical safety or financial security.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么情感安全与身体安全或经济安全同样重要。

sentences.en: And he also, I don't think this was his intention, but it's now very much used to explain how the pathway to becoming your best self.
sentences.zh: 而且他还——我不认为这是他的本意，但它现在确实被广泛用于解释通往成为最好的自己的途径。

sentences.en: If you cannot picture the pyramid at this stage, I would highly recommend quick, do a quick Google search of what it looks like because this episode will make a lot more sense
sentences.zh: 如果你现在脑海中无法浮现出那个金字塔，我强烈建议你快速在谷歌上搜索一下它的样子，因为有了这个视觉参考，这期节目会更容易理解。

sentences.en: with that visual in mind.
sentences.zh: 但让我带你从最底层开始，逐层了解每一层。

sentences.en: But let me walk you through each layer starting from the very bottom.
sentences.zh: 马斯洛金字塔的底部是我们的生理需求：食物、水、睡眠、住所，这些是维持我们生存的基本要素。

sentences.en: So at the base of Maslow's pyramid are our physiological needs, food, water, sleep, shelter, basic things required to keep us alive.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们人类生存的核心需求。

sentences.en: These are our core human survival needs.
sentences.zh: 一旦满足了这些，理论认为我们就可以开始构建安全需求。

sentences.en: Once we have those, the theory goes that we can then build our safety needs.
sentences.zh: 安全需求是下一层。

sentences.en: Safety needs is the next layer.
sentences.zh: 它本质上是说，一旦生存问题得到解决，我们就可以开始考虑长期保障和身体安全。

sentences.en: It is essentially saying once survival is taken care of, we can begin to think about long-term security and physical safety.
sentences.zh: 我们可以开始考虑我们的长期健康和日常规律，知道明天不会完全充满不确定性。

sentences.en: We can begin to think about our long-term health and about our routines, kind of knowing that tomorrow isn't going to be completely uncertain.
sentences.zh: 第三层是爱与归属感。

sentences.en: The third level is love and belonging.
sentences.zh: 人类是社会性动物，所以我们需要友谊、家庭、亲密关系、社区，我们需要有意义的人际关系，我们需要感到与他人有联系，

sentences.en: Humans are social creatures, so we need friendship, we need family, we need intimacy, community, we need meaningful relationships, we need to feel connected to other people
sentences.zh: 并被他们接纳。

sentences.en: and accepted by them.
sentences.zh: 但除非你知道下一顿饭在哪里，或者感到安全，否则这些需求无法被优先考虑。

sentences.en: But that cannot be prioritized until, you know, you know where your next meal is going to come from or until you feel safe.
sentences.zh: 所以爱与归属感是第三层。

sentences.en: So love and belonging is the third layer.
sentences.zh: 在那一层之上是尊重需求。

sentences.en: And then on top of that layer is esteem needs.
sentences.zh: 这包括自尊、自信、成就感、认可，

sentences.en: This includes self-respect, confidence, achievement, recognition,
sentences.zh: 本质上就是这种核心信念和核心感，即我们很重要，我们有价值。

sentences.en: essentially just this core belief and this core sense that we matter and we have value.
sentences.zh: 这实际上关乎我们如何看待自己，以及我们觉得别人如何看待我们。

sentences.en: It's really just about how we see ourselves and how we feel we're being perceived.
sentences.zh: 你现在大概可以看出这些需求是如何层层叠加的，直到最后我们到达金字塔的顶端，即自我实现。

sentences.en: You can kind of see at this stage how all these needs build on each other until finally we get to the top of the pyramid which is self-actualization.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前所说，我认为这是实现我们潜能、追求目标、在创造和智力上表达自我、作为个体成长，

sentences.en: As I said, I think previously, this is the desire to fulfill our potential, to pursue our purpose, to express ourselves creatively, intellectually, to grow as individuals
sentences.zh: 并成为我们有能力成为的人的愿望。

sentences.en: and to become who we are capable of becoming.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，

sentences.en: Interestingly,
sentences.zh: 在晚年，

sentences.en: later in life,
sentences.zh: 马斯洛实际上用“自我超越”取代了“自我实现”，将其作为人类的最高目标。

sentences.en: Maslow actually replaced self-actualization with self-transcendence as the highest human goal.
sentences.zh: 我说取代，其实不准确。

sentences.en: I said replaced, that's not true.
sentences.zh: 他基本上增加了一个额外的层次，那个额外的层次或级别就是自我超越。

sentences.en: He basically added an additional layer and that additional layer or level was self-transcendence.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，自我实现显得过于个人主义，随着年龄增长，他开始对人们解读它的方式产生异议。

sentences.en: Self-actualization to him was rather individualistic and he kind of took issue with how people were interpreting it the older that he got.
sentences.zh: 最终，他意识到能够善待他人，我们对他人的利他主义、同理心，将我们的好运传递下去，成为一个好的社区成员，

sentences.en: Ultimately, he realized that being able to be kind to others, our capacity for altruism, for empathy, to take our good fortune and pass it on, being a good community member,
sentences.zh: 那才是人类体验的巅峰。

sentences.en: that is the peak of the human experience.
sentences.zh: 而不是感到有成就感，也不是感到你了解你自己。

sentences.en: not feeling accomplished, not feeling like you know yourself.
sentences.zh: 马斯洛喜欢用两个词来描述这一点，它们可能是我在这个播客中说过的最难的两个词。

sentences.en: There's two words that Maslow loved to use to describe this and they are probably two of the hardest words I will ever say on this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Are we ready?
sentences.zh: 第一个是gemen，哦天哪，

sentences.en: The first is gemen, oh god,
sentences.zh: 我再试一次。

sentences.en: I'm gonna try again.
sentences.zh: 好吧，再来一次，gemen schaften get full。

sentences.en: Okay, one more time, gemen schaften get full.
sentences.zh: 可能说得很蹩脚，但这是一个德语词。

sentences.en: Probably butchered it, but it's a German word.
sentences.zh: 它的意思是关心他人所带来的心理健康。

sentences.en: It means the psychological health that follows from caring about others.
sentences.zh: 下一个词是菩萨（bodhisattva）。

sentences.en: And the next word is bodhisattva.
sentences.zh: 这是一个佛教概念，

sentences.en: It's a Buddhist notion
sentences.zh: 即一个获得满足的人，是一个努力对他人怀有慈悲心的人。

sentences.en: that somebody who is fulfilled is somebody who strives for compassion towards others.
sentences.zh: 如果我说错了，请见谅。

sentences.en: Apologies if I got those wrong.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我总是搞不定复杂的词汇。

sentences.en: I can never get my way around complex words.
sentences.zh: 我的澳大利亚口音让我想做任何不是那种粗暴、简单的英语的事情都变得非常困难。

sentences.en: My Australian accent makes it so hard to ever do anything that is not just like brutal, simple English.
sentences.zh: 但这种自我超越、菩萨的概念——那个德语词我甚至不想再试了——是教科书里不包含的东西。

sentences.en: But this idea of self-transcendence, of bodhisattva, of I'm not even gonna try the German one, is something that textbooks
sentences.zh: 我以前学习心理学时，从来没见过有人谈论这个。

sentences.en: don't include.
sentences.zh: 本质上，我真的在强调这一点，因为我认为这非常重要，自我实现固然很好。

sentences.en: I've never seen this spoken about, at least when I was studying psychology.
sentences.zh: 但你用它来做什么呢？

sentences.en: Essentially, and I'm really drilling this point home because I think, I just think it's such an important point, it's all fine and great to self-actualize.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有与他人建立联系，你真的能作为一个成就卓著的个体，孤独地待在象牙塔里获得满足吗？

sentences.en: But what do you even do with that?
sentences.zh: 如果你没有对他人的同理心，从而驱使你去与他们联系、给予他们、善待他们？

sentences.en: Like, can you truly be fulfilled as an accomplished individual, alone in your ivory tower, if you are not connected to other people?
sentences.zh: 对马斯洛来说，那是最高级的心理状态。

sentences.en: And if you do not have empathy for other people that drives you to connect with them and give on to them and be kind to them?
sentences.zh: 所以这是人们关于马斯洛需求层次理论不知道的一件事。

sentences.en: That, to Maslow, was the most enlightened psychological state.
sentences.zh: 实际上还有另一个特殊的额外层次，我们需要实现的另一件事。

sentences.en: So that's one thing people don't know about Maslow's hierarchy of needs.
sentences.zh: 我们经常搞错的另一件事是，请击鼓，

sentences.en: There is actually another special bonus layer, another thing we need to achieve.
sentences.zh: 马斯洛实际上从未将他的层次结构展示或表述为一个金字塔。

sentences.en: The other thing we often get wrong is that, drumroll please,
sentences.zh: 他甚至很少将其称为层次结构。

sentences.en: Maslow actually never displayed or articulated his hierarchy as a pyramid.
sentences.zh: 根据心理学家斯科特·巴里·考夫曼的说法，他实际上接手了马斯洛未发表的作品，并将其使命定为扩展这些理论，

sentences.en: He very rarely even referred to it as a hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 我们非常熟悉的这个金字塔描述，实际上是由管理顾问创造的，他们试图推销该模型的特定解读。

sentences.en: According to the psychologist Scott
sentences.zh: 这种描述，

sentences.en: Barry Kaufman, who actually took on Maslow's unpublished work and made it his mission to expand upon these theories, this pyramid depiction that we are so familiar with
sentences.zh: 考夫曼认为，实际上，他说这严重损害了马斯洛的原始理论。

sentences.en: was actually created by management consultants who were trying to sell a particular interpretation of the model.
sentences.zh: 它真的把它简化了。

sentences.en: This depiction,
sentences.zh: 在英国心理学会的一篇文章中，他们谈到金字塔描述如何暗示我们通往自我实现、自我超越的旅程几乎像是一个电子游戏，

sentences.en: Kaufman argues actually, he says it's done a great disservice to Maslow's original theory.
sentences.zh: 它引导人们假设你在生活中通过解锁从一层到下一层再到下一层的门来升级。

sentences.en: It's really simplified it.
sentences.zh: 马斯洛的概念是，每一组需求——你的社会需求、尊重需求、生存需求——都是相互依存的，它们必须同时被体验。

sentences.en: In an article by the British
sentences.zh: 这个层次结构需要以一种整合的方式来看待。

sentences.en: Psychological Society, they speak about how the pyramid depiction suggests that our journey towards self-actualization, self-transcendence operates almost like a video game
sentences.zh: 也就是说，每一组需求都建立在彼此之上，不是以连续的方式，而是以一种循环的方式。

sentences.en: and it kind of leads people to assume that you level up in life by unlocking the door from one layer to the next to the next to the next.
sentences.zh: 这种金字塔描述不能很好解释的另一件事是，人们如何在没有完全满足之前每一层的情况下，处于不同的阶段。

sentences.en: Maslow's conceptualization was that each cluster of needs, your social needs, your esteem needs, your survival needs are interdependent and they have to be experienced
sentences.zh: 例如，那些不一定觉得有很好社会支持的人，可能真的很孤独，没有与家庭单位甚至社区建立联系的人，

sentences.en: simultaneously.
